review_notes: Viewed previews/page-0006.png and compared every item with evidence/page-0006.json. Text-only end-matter page: references 19-31 in the left column, 32-36 plus Publisher's note, Open Access and the copyright line in the right column; the bottom half of the page is blank. Reading order (p0006-b002..b014 then p0006-b015..b022) was already correct. Changes: (1) removed the space before the comma after every bold volume number in refs 19-36 ('**12** , 031010' -> '**12**, 031010'). (2) p0006-b006 (ref. 23): the preprint DOI was broken across a line as 'https://doi.org/10.1101/' + '2023.04.25.537981' and the extractor left a space inside the URL; rejoined to https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.04.25.537981. (3) p0006-b015 (ref. 32): '_N_ -glycosylation' had a stray space after the italic N; corrected to '_N_-glycosylation'. (4) Checked and deliberately left as printed: ref. 20's title reads 'hybrid quantum-classical framework' with a plain HYPHEN in the source, unlike the en dash used in the body text - verified in the native text and not normalized. Ref. 21's 'KRas<sup>G12D</sup>' superscript is correct against the preview, and ref. 22's 'KRas(G12D)' is genuinely parenthesised in the source. 'Virtualflow 2.0—the next generation' is an em dash; 'membrane–protein' (ref. 30) and all page ranges are en dashes; 'Römisch' and 'Götzke' keep their umlauts and '© The Author(s) 2025' keeps U+00A9. (5) No cross-page joins are needed at either boundary: page 5 ends with reference 18 and this page opens with reference 19 (separate list items), and this page ends with the copyright line while page 7 opens with the 'Methods' heading. (6) Header items p0006-b000/b001 and footer p0006-b023 confirmed as running furniture (left as text); bare page number 1959 kept as 'omit'. Coordinator: running header/footer furniture set to explicit omit, matching the treatment reviewers applied on pages 8-18, so both verification parsers exclude the same regions.
